not-for-you.title: Not For You
stanzas: I mind my own business
Focus on my own things
So why do you have the nerve to
Comment on my upbringing
These random people want to
Push me down
But they don’t even know me
And what I’m all about
You don’t like the way I act
You think that I’m a spoiled brat
Make rumors ‘bout me that aren’t true
Good thing, I’m not for you
You think that I am too much
Sometimes you say I’m not enough
Try to come up with something new
Cause good thing, I’m not for you
You choose to talk about me
Saying words that make no sense
I was never rude to you
Why would you try and affect my confidence
You do not even have my number
So why would I give you my time
When you sit alone typing hate
And I’m on stage and about to shine
You don’t like the way I act
You think that I’m a spoiled brat
Make rumors ‘bout me that aren’t true
Good thing I’m not for you
You think that I am too much
Sometimes you say I’m not enough
Try to come up with something new
Cause good thing, I’m not for you
I’m not here to please everybody
Loving myself is enough
People who really know me, know what I’m made of
So if you don’t know me
Shut up
You don’t like the way I act
You think that I’m a spoiled brat
Make rumors ‘bout me that aren’t true
Good thing I’m not for you
You think that I am too much
Sometimes you say I’m not enough
Try to come up with something new
Cause good thing, I’m not for you

let-you-be.title: Let You Be
stanzas: We’ve been close friends for a while now
But it’s seems like you’ve changed
Used to fill me with joy, I remember
But now it’s not the same
If someone’s more well known you like them overall
Better than me, Better than me
Maybe I’m not the latest trend
But I’m still me, and I can see
When we are together
I let go of the past
Every lie you said to my face
When you left me in the trash
And I know you value popularity over friends like me
So why can’t I just let you be, let you be
I can’t let you be, let you be
We share with one another, all our secrets
But mine are never safe
You’d go and tell the whole world all my skeletons
You think they’d know your name
And everyday you’re like talking to a brick wall
Everything you say is fake
I wanna keep our friendship growing
But you give and take away
If someone’s more well known you like them overall
Better than me, Better than me
Maybe I’m not the latest trend
But I’m still me, and I can see
When we are together
I let go of the past
Every lie you said to my face
When you left me in the trash
And I know you value popularity over friends like me
So why can’t I just let you be, let you be
I can’t let you be
When we are together
I let go of the past
Every lie you said to my face
When you left me in the trash
And I know you value popularity over friends like me
So why can’t I just let you be, let you be
I can’t let you be, let you be

breakup-with-my-ego.title: Breakup with My Ego
stanzas: Don’t fan my ego my love
Not letting you take over
It pretends to be my best friend
But now I’m getting older
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go go
It’s only human nature
To get fooled with lies and greed
And I can’t let pride take over
When temptation’s following me
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go go
Don’t fool me with those praises
My ship has anchored now
Don’t raise the heat of desire
The waves will crash them down
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go go
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go
I want to have a breakup now
I wanna have a breakup with my ego, go go now

life-vest.title: Life Vest
stanzas: Swim up to the surface to try and catch my breath
Through all the waves of life, you’ve known me better than the rest
No one can pull me down when I’m with you
You help me see the world from a new view
If I can’t be you
At least you’re my best friend
You’re my life vest when I’m drowning
You’re my helmet when I fall
You’re the shoulder that I lean on
When I’m scared and feeling small
You’re always there for me
And I try to do that too
But no matter what I do
I could never be like you
This song isn’t supposed to be about jealousy
But after spending time with you, I don’t want to be me
No one could say a bad thing about you
But I’m just filled with flaws through and through
If I can’t be you
At least you’re my best friend
You’re my life vest when I’m drowning
You’re my helmet when I fall
You’re the shoulder that I lean on
When I’m scared and feeling small
You’re always there for me
And I try to do that too
But no matter what I do
I could never be like you
When I am with you, I perceive the world in a whole new kind of light
See less flaws and I sense the brighter side
I know why small matters can’t make us fight
You’re my life vest when I’m drowning
You’re my helmet when I fall
You’re the shoulder that I lean on
When I’m scared and feeling small
You’re always there for me
And I try to do that too
But no matter what I do
I could never be like you
